intro: Demont's Place is a ruined homestead nestled in southwestern Westfall, just west of the forsaken town of Moonbrook. Once a working agricultural plot, the farm was driven to ruin alongside the rest of the region and claimed by the rogue agents of the Defias Brotherhood. Today, its weathered fences and empty fields stand as another casualty of the realm's fading prosperity.

p: Situated within sight of Moonbrook, Demont's Place was once among the private family holdings feeding the Kingdom of Stormwind. Economic collapse and the sudden rise of outlaw brigands stripped the farm of its livelihood, forcing out its original caretakers. Much like its neighboring fields, the plot has degenerated into a rough hideout, overrun by outlaws using its weathered grounds as an extension of the Defias stronghold in Moonbrook.

Because of its close proximity to Moonbrook, Demont's Place serves the Defias Brotherhood as an operational outpost on the outskirts of their regional center. Thugs, cutpurses, and displaced laborers linger among the fences and shattered structures, ambushing travelers who wander off the southern roads. Until Moonbrook is reclaimed and the outlaws broken, the ground remains far too dangerous for peaceful farming to ever return.
